comment: Independent zap.c witness for bhitm()'s WAN_MAKE_INVISIBLE message: a Samurai wearing a wished-for helm of telepathy zaps a wand of make invisible at her little dog. display.c knowninvisible() tests HTelepat & ~INTRINSIC, not the helm's extrinsic telepathy, so it is false; the dog was seen and no longer is, so C prints "Hachi vanishes!" rather than "turns transparent". The dog then fights a summoned jackal while invisible.
